text: DSH Mine Sweeper 是面向 DSH 网页端的扫雷小游戏，在会话区域旁注册可拖动、可折叠的浮层面板。玩家可设置行数、列数和雷数，点击格子揭开、右击插旗，并可重开当前棋盘；首点会避开雷区。游戏状态保存在浏览器内存中，刷新后不保留。适合想在 DSH 网页会话旁玩轻量扫雷的用户，无需额外密钥或外部服务。

DSH Mine Sweeper adds a draggable, collapsible Minesweeper overlay beside DSH web conversations. Set board size and mine count, reveal or flag cells, and restart. The first reveal is safe. Game state stays in browser memory and is lost on refresh. No key or external service is required.
想在 DSH 聊天页面旁边放个可以拖动的扫雷小游戏。
能不能在网页会话边玩扫雷，还能自己调棋盘大小和雷数？
I want a small Minesweeper game floating beside my DSH conversation.
DSH Mine Sweeper 的功能「自定义棋盘扫雷」：在面板中设置 5 到 30 行、5 到 30 列及雷数后开始新局；点击格子揭开，右击插旗，首次点击会避开该格及周围格的雷。
DSH Mine Sweeper 的功能「可拖动与折叠浮层」：游戏面板注册在 DSH 的 shell.overlay 区域，可拖至屏幕其他位置；折叠后显示炸弹按钮，点击可重新展开，标题栏按钮可重开当前棋盘。

@meng_long/dsh-mine-sweeper README · dsh-mine-sweeper：Minesweeper overlay for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). A draggable, collapsible board floats over the left side of the conversation area — the empty strip next to the sidebar — so you can play while the agent works.

@meng_long/dsh-mine-sweeper README · dsh-mine-sweeper：- Custom board: rows and columns 5–30, mine count 1 … rows×cols−9.
- First click is always safe (mines are planted after it, avoiding the clicked cell and its ring).
- Right-click to flag, `↻` restarts the same board, `–` collapses to a single 💣 button.
- Losing reveals every mine plus the flags that were wrong; clearing every safe cell wins.
- Nothing is persisted: state lives in React memory and is gone when you refresh or stop the service.

@meng_long/dsh-mine-sweeper README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin add @meng_long/dsh-mine-sweeper
```

Or install the npm package `@meng_long/dsh-mine-sweeper` from the plugin market, then restart `dsh web`.

@meng_long/dsh-mine-sweeper README · How it plugs in：The panel registers into the `shell.overlay` slot (a list slot covering the whole frame), entry id `sweeper`, order 60. It positions itself absolutely inside that layer, so it never enters the `AppFrame` grid and never pushes the sidebar, conversation or composer around.

The host half (`index.js`) is intentionally empty: everything lives in the browser bundle (`client.js`). `cordis.patch.yml` exists so the package can be installed as a bundle.

@meng_long/dsh-mine-sweeper README · Development：```sh
npm run check   # node --check on both halves
npm test        # bundle contract + game core smoke test
```
